axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y). Hall space: x east, z south (north = -z), y up.
hallOriginNote: Every zone asset is placed at the hall origin (its placement is [0,0,0], yaw 0): its part centres, colliders and attachments are hall coordinates. TC_Chest and TC_Dummy carry one placement per copy (position + yawDeg about Y in hall space).

triangles.note: drawn = every placed copy; a view of the hall sees most of it but not the platform's far ends or the corridor

attributes.note: BlenderTemplates.TRAIN_AT equivalent for copy B: CFrame.new(hall * (36.5, 0, 97.5)) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-90), 0); the side doors open on the north side

attributes.drill: 8 clean hits on the blocker and parrier, block or parry 2 of the striker's blows, in 25 s
3 hits from 5 throws at 20 or more
fire, bottle, plants, bandage in 45 s
wall top under 8 s; bikes 20 s in the green; 10 clean lifts

attributes.note: allies are offered here; the kit board

lampNote: Hall: a PointLight at each Lamp_ii_jj marker whose attribute light is true (Range 40, Brightness 1.4, Colour (236, 240, 236), Shadows on only for Lamp_05_03 and Lamp_07_05); the Downlight discs are Neon. Platform: PlatLamp_b_k PointLights (Range 22, Brightness 1.2, warm) switched with the PlatLamp<b> Neon bar. Corridor: Lamp_Corr_n red (Range 12).
import: Insert the upload; each asset root arrives as a Model with one MeshPart per role named <Asset>_<Role>.

Place each MeshPart at hall * placement * CFrame.new(part.center) * CFrame.Angles(0, pi, 0) (the importer turns meshes 180 degrees about Y), Anchored, CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off; Color and Material from rgb and robloxMaterial; Transparency from transparency; CastShadow from castShadow.

Colliders: build plain invisible Parts from 'colliders' (centre, size, yawDeg about Y), CanCollide on, CanQuery on, CollisionFidelity irrelevant (Parts). Tags: Climbable, TrainingTarget (+ attributes Station, Lane, Distance), LaunchDoorLeaf (Side, OpenX), RedRoomSeam (remove once the red room stands behind it).
Markers are manifest-only (empties in TrainingCentre.blend): attachments per asset, 'markers' in hall space. Spawn_01..48 are on platform B and must NOT become enabled SpawnLocations.

assets.name: TC_Platform
assets.notes: Platform B, where train copy B stands: a dark covered platform 300 long beside the hall's south wall, level with the train floor (y 0). The three arches lead up into the hall. Lamp banks PlatLamp1..6 (Neon) switch on bank by bank as the train stops. The track pit, the guideway (top y -3.4, the train's skirt bottom) and a tunnel portal at both ends (the tunnel stubs end in black).
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

attributes.note: BlenderTemplates.TRAIN_AT equivalent for copy B: CFrame.new(hall * (36.5, 0, 97.5)) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-90), 0); the side doors open on the north side

assets.name: TC_HallShell
assets.notes: The hall: 220 x 150 x 36 inside. Blue-grey chequered carpet (5-stud squares), teal padded wall panels leaning in toward the top, white diagonal ribs, a coffered ceiling with 77 round downlights, three arches in the south wall onto platform B, the north wall's steel door surround with the big screen over it and two stacks of colour-bar boards. Floor centre = place (8800, 200, 3000).
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

assets.name: TC_Archery
assets.notes: Archery lanes: 6 lanes 8 wide (x 48..96), the shooting line at z 66, pop-up targets on orange stands at 20, 40 and 60 studs (z 46, 26, 6), a padded backstop at z -8. Each target board has a TrainingTarget collider (attributes Lane, Distance). The Archer mat and the station chest stand east of the line.
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

assets.name: TC_BladeRing
assets.notes: Blade and axe circle: a padded ring r 14 centred (-75, 7.5) with a cream rim, four dummy stands at r 8 (Dummy_Target N, Dummy_Blocker E, Dummy_Parrier S, Dummy_Striker W, each facing the centre), a spinning post with two padded arms, and an orange weapon cart with the five blades on show.
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

attributes.drill: 8 clean hits on the blocker and parrier, block or parry 2 of the striker's blows, in 25 s

assets.name: TC_SpearRange
assets.notes: Spear and throwing range: the throw line at x 52 (orange), throwing boards at 10..50 studs (x 62..102) facing the thrower, two orange spear racks, hay bales as a backstop on the east wall. The Hunter mat.
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

attributes.drill: 3 hits from 5 throws at 20 or more

assets.name: TC_Survival
assets.notes: Survival corner: a stone fire pit with logs (hold E at FirePit), three snare stakes with cord loops, a plant table with six pots (three sound, three spoiled: never poisonous), a wooden trough with water, the bandage dummy's stand. Forager and Medic mats.
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

attributes.drill: fire, bottle, plants, bandage in 45 s

assets.name: TC_Fitness
assets.notes: Fitness corner: a climbing wall 30 wide x 24 high against the west wall (orange holds; its collider is tagged Climbable), four exercise bikes with orange frames, a weight rack with a padded bench, a climbing rope from the ceiling. The Climber mat in front of the wall.
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

attributes.drill: wall top under 8 s; bikes 20 s in the green; 10 clean lifts

assets.name: TC_PrepFloor
assets.notes: The floor (prep area): the running track (lane 4 wide, one lap = 300 studs on its centre line), the obstacle run inside it (vault box, mantle wall, slide bar, start and finish lines), eight benches facing the kit board (KitBoard marker: a SurfaceGui face 16 x 9).
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

attributes.note: allies are offered here; the kit board

assets.name: TC_LaunchDoors
assets.notes: The launch doors and corridor. A steel surround on the north wall (x -16..16) under the big screen, a red lamp over the opening, two oxblood pocket-door leaves (8 x 14 together) that slide 4.2 into the wall (DoorLeafL/R + DoorTrimL/R move together; colliders DoorL_Col/DoorR_Col), then a corridor 6 wide, 9 high and 10 long through to z -87 (place z 2913), oxblood walls, red light strips at floor level, a blue-grey steel floor with white stripes. TC_LaunchDoors_EndCap (black) closes the corridor until the red room stands behind it; remove it then.
assets.pivot: hall floor centre (placed at the hall origin)

assets.name: TC_Chest
assets.notes: The station chest (lends that station's items; hold E 0.6 s). Steel-blue body with orange straps, lid separate: TC_Chest_Lid + TC_Chest_LidUse rotate about LidHinge (+X axis, back top edge), ~100 degrees opens it. Front = -Z (LookVector).
assets.pivot: floor centre of the chest; front = -Z

assets.name: TC_Dummy
assets.notes: A burlap training dummy at blocky-R15 proportions, one MeshPart per R15 limb (TC_Dummy_<R15 name>), a canvas vest on the UpperTorso, standing on a steel plate (TC_Dummy_Stand, 0.3 high). To swap DummyBuilder's look, put each mesh at its R15 part's CFrame (the manifest gives each part's centre).
assets.pivot: ground centre under the feet; front = -Z

attributes.note: HumanoidRootPart centre for the R15 swap

notes: 19 Nov 2026 (wave 15): uploaded once by the lead through Open Cloud POST /assets/v1/assets (creator user 5458010221), Blender uploads for this game approved by the owner on 19 Nov. Never re-upload this file; reuse its id. A re-export needs a new upload (new id) recorded here.
